title: Partners (2012 TV series)
premise_summary: Partners is an American television sitcom that aired on CBS from September 24 to November 12, 2012, on Monday nights at 8:30 p.m., following the sitcom How I Met Your Mother. The series was created by Will & Grace creators Max Mutchnick and David Kohan, who also served as the show's executive producers, and stars Michael Urie, David Krumholtz, Sophia Bush, and Brandon Routh.
